action_language.ordering: Lexicographic Cartesian order over ACTION6 then ACTION7 at lengths 1, 2, and 3.
action_language.reset: Every word begins from canonical P0 in a fresh isolated process.

adapter_and_oia.adapter: Complete deterministic bounded prefix-tree Mealy compilation.

claim_boundary: Opened Track A candidate admission and exact OIA separator selection before held-out post-P0 outcome access. No real ARC action, outcome-agreement, decision-value, private/sealed transfer, or Track B claim.

epistemic_ordering.next_outcome_gate: If and only if at least two candidates pass and OIA selects an exact separator, merge that result before authorizing extraction of the matching public archive outcome.

p0.replay: initial_state(copy of P0) followed by render must reproduce exact P0 bytes.

runtime_isolation.candidate_and_p0_mounts: read-only; prepared P0 mount contains initial_frame.txt only
runtime_isolation.candidate_runtime_calls: No ARC, model, OIA, browser, API, hosted service, or host archive access from candidate processes.
runtime_isolation.container: Unprivileged UID/GID 65532, read-only root, no network, all capabilities dropped, no-new-privileges, bounded CPU/memory/PIDs/timeout, isolated noexec tmpfs.

screening.full_determinism: For each provisional unique candidate and every word, run two repetitions under PYTHONHASHSEED 0, 1, 5, and 10. All projected traces must be byte-identical and successful.
screening.hardened_static: Reapply the frozen generation AST contract, then reject dangerous names and NumPy/file serialization attributes without importing candidate code.
screening.p0: Run empty-word exact replay for every static-pass candidate.
screening.provisional: Run every word once under PYTHONHASHSEED=0 and retain the first candidate in frozen order for each complete trace signature.
screening.success: At least two exact-P0, replay-consistent, deterministic, behaviorally non-equivalent candidates are required; exactly two is sufficient.
